info.name: REST api to TON blockchain explorer Accounts Rewards API

params.name: seqno
params.description: Masterchain block seqno. Defaults to latest. Mutually exclusive with `unixtime`.

params.name: unixtime
params.description: Unix timestamp (seconds). Looks up the masterchain block at this time and uses it as the anchor. Mutually exclusive with `seqno`.

params.name: shallow
params.description: Set to `1` to return only basic validator info (rank, pubkey, effective_stake, weight, reward, pool). Skips pool type detection, owner/validator addresses, nominator data, and returned-stake lookup — significantly faster.

items.docs: Returns all current validators with stakes, rewards, pool addresses, and (optionally) nominator breakdowns.

params.name: election_id
params.description: Return the single round matching this election ID. Mutually exclusive with `block` and `unixtime`.

params.name: block
params.description: Find the round containing this masterchain block seqno and return it plus up to `limit-1` older rounds. Mutually exclusive with `election_id` and `unixtime`.

params.name: unixtime
params.description: Unix timestamp (seconds). Looks up the masterchain block at this time and uses it as the anchor. Mutually exclusive with `election_id` and `block`.

items.docs: Returns past and current validation rounds with boundaries, stakes, and bonuses. Always uses the latest masterchain block.

info.name: Get per-validator reward distribution for a finished round

params.name: election_id
params.description: Election ID of the finished round. Mutually exclusive with `block` and `unixtime`.

params.name: block
params.description: Masterchain block seqno within the finished round. Mutually exclusive with `election_id` and `unixtime`.

params.name: unixtime
params.description: Unix timestamp (seconds). Looks up the masterchain block at this time and uses it as the anchor. Mutually exclusive with `election_id` and `block`.

params.name: shallow
params.description: Set to `1` to return only basic validator info (rank, pubkey, effective_stake, weight, reward, pool). Skips pool type detection, owner/validator addresses, nominator data, and returned-stake lookup — significantly faster.

items.docs: Computes per-validator and per-nominator reward distribution for a finished validation round using the elector's bonuses value.

info.name: Get historical APY and stake statistics

items.docs: Returns time series of APY and total stake from past validation rounds.
Returns the current TON blockchain APY as a percent based on the latest completed validation round.
